summary: BM25 + dense retrieval -> RRF -> LambdaMART over 17 features. No cross-encoder, one XGBoost model, ~0.90 NDCG@10.

dead_features.seniority_fit: providers.json has no `seniority` field (0/3024), so this is constant 0.5 at train time and 0.0 at serve time. Kept in the vector because the saved model indexes features positionally.
dead_features.budget_fit: emitted as 0.0: the shipped model was trained on zeros, so live values would be out-of-distribution. Data now supports it (budget_lo/hi + rate_per_hour, both 100%); retraining on live values scored 0.8962, identical, so the zeros were kept.
dead_features.avail_immediacy: same as budget_fit: supported by the data (available_from + start_by, 100%), trained on zeros.
